title: Decoded Machine from a Binary String
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string. The machine assigned to $\alpha$ by the $K$-machine construction associated with $c$ is equal to the underlying machine decoded from $\alpha$.
replaced:
For every effective machine coding $c$ and every binary string $\alpha$, the machine
produced by applying the coding's associated $K$-machine construction to $\alpha$ is
equal to the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
